extension.summary: PlayStation 2 style clock, cubes and rings overlays for the Kodi home screen
extension.description: Transparent PlayStation 2 style animations: the crystal clock (the current hour bar shines), floating glass cubes, orbiting rings and a cinematic double light sweep. Each animation with its own on/off switch and settings (clock with hour shine, cubes, rings, light sweep). Fade in/out times are global. Does not steal focus or input.
